originalTitle: S&P 500 ends higher as CoreWeave results fuel AI optimism
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks closed mostly higher on Wednesday, with the Dow the only outlier, ending virtually flat, the S&P 500 gaining about a quarter of a percent, and the Nasdaq adding more than half a percent. :: CoreWeave Upbeat quarterly results from AI-related firms continued to soothe investor fears about massive capex spending. :: CoreWeave Shares of CoreWeave, for instance, surged 19% after the AI cloud company lifted its annual capital spending forecast and topped second-quarter earnings estimates. Mike Mussio is president of FBB Capital Partners. “We continue to see some of these names that sold off dramatically in June and part of July on just general AI over-investment, scare around that, they're actually reporting earnings, and the earnings are kind of saying, 'nothing really to see here.' So some of these same companies and sub-industries within the AI complex that sold off hard are bouncing dramatically. And that's helping lead the Nasdaq higher today.” Data center operators also rose, with IREN gaining almost 10% and Applied Digital up nearly 5%. :: Nebius Group And shares of data center company Nebius Group jumped 34%, helped by second-quarter results that beat expectations. Shares of Super Micro Computer surged 19% after the AI server maker forecast fiscal 2027 revenue above Wall Street expectations. And chip makers gained, with Nvidia rising 3% and Micron Technology adding about 5%. Meanwhile, data on Wednesday showed U.S. consumer prices barely increased in July as the cost of gasoline declined for a second straight month, further reducing expectations of an interest rate hike next month from the Federal Reserve.

chineseTitle: CoreWeave 业绩推动 AI 乐观情绪，标普 500 指数收高
chineseSummary: 故事：美国股市周三收盘大多走高，道琼斯指数是唯一例外，收盘几乎持平，标准普尔 500 指数上涨约 25%，纳斯达克指数上涨超过 0.5%。 :: CoreWeave 人工智能相关公司的乐观季度业绩继续缓解投资者对巨额资本支出的担忧。 :: 例如，在人工智能云公司 CoreWeave 上调年度资本支出预测并超出第二季度盈利预期后，其股价飙升 19%。迈克·穆西奥 (Mike Mussio) 是 FBB Capital Partners 总裁。 “我们继续看到其中一些公司在 6 月和 7 月部分时间因一般人工智能过度投资而大幅抛售，对此感到害怕，他们实际上正在报告收益，而收益有点像是在说，‘这里没什么可看的。’”因此，人工智能综合体中的一些公司和子行业经历了大幅抛售，但现在却出现了大幅反弹。这有助于今天纳斯达克指数走高。”数据中心运营商也有所上涨，IREN 上涨近 10%，Applied Digital 上涨近 5%。 :: Nebius Group 受第二季度业绩超出预期的推动，数据中心公司 Nebius Group 的股价上涨 34%。人工智能服务器制造商超微电脑 (Super Micro Computer) 预测 2027 财年收入高于华尔街预期，该公司股价飙升 19%。芯片制造商上涨，Nvidia 上涨 3%，Micron Technology 上涨约 5%。与此同时，周三的数据显示，由于汽油成本连续第二个月下降，美国7月份消费者价格几乎没有上涨，进一步降低了美联储下个月加息的预期。
